item.title: Remembering Mary B. Darby
item.description: Mary B. Darby, 87, passed away peacefully at her home on Tuesday, March 3, 2026, after a lengthy illness. Mary was born on March 22, 1938, in Covington to Lamar Bosshammer and Dolly Mae Crisler Bosshammer. A Shreveport resident for 55 years, she built a life centered on faith, family, and community. item.title: NSU Shreveport campus will resume normal operations today
item.description: Northwestern State University’s Shreveport campus, located at 1800 Line Ave., will resume operations on Thursday, March 5. Regularly scheduled classes, labs, clinical experiences, office operations and student services will resume. Faculty, staff and students should report to campus and other assigned learning sites as scheduled and are encouraged to bring bottled water for drinking. item.description: The Shreveport Fire Deparment responded to a fire at the Jolie Apartments on Quail Creek the morning of March 4, which began around 10:30 am in a unit located near the back of the apartment complex.
